description: Top-level qodec manifest. Identifies a single lowering chain by listing its layers from most-abstract to most-concrete. Each layer references its ISA, codes, and YAML gadget documents; the layer supplies each gadget's source ISA, target ISA, and mnemonic. Loading requires an explicit manifest or bundle file path. Only referenced artifacts and gadget components are read: the referencing field determines the type, not a filename suffix. There is no recursive directory scan or required directory layout; unreferenced files and bundle entries are ignored. Paths resolve relative to the containing manifest or gadget, preserving leading `..` components. A bundle's first document is a single-entry `{path: manifest}` envelope with an unrestricted key; remaining entries are looked up by referenced path, including raw circuit-source text.

schema_version.description: Codec schema version. A single non-negative integer that is bumped on every breaking change. The current version is 1. Loaders reject manifests whose declared value differs from `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION`; omission means the loader's current version.

layers.description: Ordered list of layers, top (logical) to bottom (physical). Each layer names its ISA file and lists its gadgets by the mnemonic each implements.

instruction_set.description: Path to this layer's ISA document, relative to the manifest. The field determines the artifact type; no filename suffix is required.

codes.description: This layer's codes keyed by the block-type name they encode (as declared in this layer's `instruction_set`); the value is a code document path relative to the manifest, with no required filename suffix. Usually omitted on the bottom layer, whose blocks are physical; a binding there states which code the physical blocks already carry, which a layer below would otherwise name. Binds each block type to its code once, on the layer, so a gadget's `in`/`out` entry needs only its support.

gadgets.description: This layer's gadgets keyed by the mnemonic each implements; the value is a YAML gadget document path relative to the manifest, with no required filename suffix. Raw circuit-source files are not gadget documents: use a document containing just `circuit: ./idle.stim` for a circuit-only gadget. The layer supplies its implemented instruction and target ISA. Omitted for the bottom layer.

metadata.description: Optional free-form annotations. qodec carries this object through load and save unchanged and never interprets it (though it does participate in structural equality). Use it for tool- or author-specific data (timings, provenance, tags, vendor hints). qodec reserves no keys; namespacing by tool (e.g. an `acme` or `ibm` sub-object) is a recommendation, not a rule.
